verdict.rationale: Retell's public pricing page describes pay-as-you-go usage pricing starting at $0 with no annual contract, and offers a calculator for an approximate monthly cost; new accounts also get $10 in free credits to test before committing. A community thread cites a 17¢/min rate, and the founder notes that voice-provider choice changes the price. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of the actual per-minute rate breakdown (LLM, voice, telephony components), an explicit per-call (not monthly) estimate, and independent hands-on confirmation of the calculator's accuracy.
